title: EBP container (EBP2, 20 sections)

container.notes: Little-endian. 0x80-byte header: magic 'EBP2' at 0x00, unknown/unused 0x04-0x0F, 20 u32 absolute section offsets at 0x10-0x5F (0 = absent), unused 0x60-0x7F. Section data from 0x80, each section zero-padded to 16. Length of a section = next larger non-zero offset minus its offset (end of file for the highest). Section 6 is a TIM2 texture, section 19 is a nested ARD (FF12AR03). Sections 2/3 are text tables, section 0 is compiled script.

fields.name: headerWord04
fields.notes: Unknown; reference packer writes 0. Preserve the original value.

fields.name: reserved08
fields.notes: Unused per reference packer (written as zeros). Preserve the original bytes.

fields.name: sectionOffset00
fields.notes: Section 0: compiled script. 0 = absent. Section names for all 20 slots: enum EbpSection.

fields.name: sectionOffset06
fields.notes: Section 6: TIM2 texture. 0 = absent. Must survive repack.

fields.name: sectionOffset10
fields.notes: Section 10: camera mappings, second set (CML1). 0 = absent.

fields.name: sectionOffset12
fields.notes: Section 12: models (u32 count + s32 ids). 0 = absent.

fields.name: reserved60
fields.notes: Unused / alignment to 0x80; reference packer writes zeros. Preserve the original bytes.

roundTrip: Preserve header bytes 0x04-0x0F and 0x60-0x7F from the original file.
Keep sections in their original physical order (sort by original offset); write each at a 16-byte boundary followed by zero padding.
Absent sections stay at offset 0; present sections stay present.
Section 6 (TIM2) must be carried through; do not lose it because of file naming during unpack/repack.
Rebuild the nested ARD (section 19) before rebuilding the EBP.
Copy unedited sections byte-for-byte, including their trailing padding.
gaps: Meaning of header 0x04-0x0F; loader keeps a 'Pre-Z EBP file size' that may relate. Unverified.
Whether vanilla EBPs store sections in index order.
VBF folders of location vs event EBPs.
Runtime slots 1-3 names are not stated in the sources (only 0 = Battle, 4 = Debug).
